patch.summary:
Choose Clearbit only if your buying job matches “HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelli” rather than LinkedIn Sales Navigator's shape. Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — C” rather than Clearbit's shape. Workflow advantage: Clearbit leans data-enrichment, contact-management; LinkedIn Sales Navigator leans prospecting, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Clearbit is HubSpot-owned enrichment (Clearbit → Breeze Intelligence) for CRM fill and inbound intelligence — usage/credits via HubSpot, Starter+ requir; LinkedIn Sales Navigator is LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — Core from US$119.99/mo; Advanced Plus for CRM sync..
- Company-size focus: Clearbit (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs LinkedIn Sales Navigator (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clearbit-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management vs LinkedIn Sales Navigator-leaning prospecting, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Clearbit — Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; LinkedIn Sales Navigator — Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info.

Limitations — Clearbit: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric; No standalone free plan; typically needs HubSpot Starter+; LinkedIn Sales Navigator: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; No bulk InMail; messages are individual with monthly InMail credits (50/mo stated on plans).

Poor-fit cases: Clearbit is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Now HubSpot-owned and repositioned as Breeze Intelligence — buying motion is HubSpot-centric · LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info · Avoid Clearbit if you actually need LinkedIn Sales Navigator's motion (LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
